intents.definition: The buyer wants to know how to pay and which payment methods are available to complete a purchase.
examples: How do I pay for my order?
Which payment methods can I use, BLIK or card?
Do you support Apple Pay and Google Pay for checkout?
Jak zaplacic za zamowienie blikiem?
Czy moge zapłacić kartą z 3DS?
There's no pay button anywhere, where do I actually send the money?
Chcę kupić ale nie wiem gdzie kliknąć żeby opłacić, pomóżcie
not: This is NOT buyer_how_to_pay if the payment was already attempted and got rejected — that is buyer_payment_failed.

intents.definition: The buyer tried to pay but the payment was rejected or failed and they want to know what to do next.
examples: My card payment was rejected, what now?
Transaction failed twice, why can't I pay?
BLIK keeps saying error when I confirm in the app.
Platnosc odrzucona, co mam zrobic zeby zaplacic?
Płatność się nie powiodła, kod BLIK nie przechodzi.
It just says something went wrong, I've tried three cards and none work.
znowu blad przy platnosci!! nie da sie u was kupic niczego
not: This is NOT buyer_payment_failed if money left the account but the shop shows unpaid — that is buyer_money_taken_no_order.
This is NOT buyer_payment_failed if the buyer only asks which methods exist — that is buyer_how_to_pay.

intents.definition: The buyer sees money debited from their account but the shop still shows the order as unpaid.
examples: Money left my account but the shop says I haven't paid.
I was charged but the order status is still unpaid, help.
Card got debited, order not confirmed — where did my money go?
Pieniadze zeszly z konta a sklep pokazuje nieoplacone.
Zapłaciłem, bank pokazuje obciążenie, a zamówienie wisi jako nieopłacone.
Bank sent me a confirmation SMS but the store acts like nothing happened.
sciagneliscie mi kase a zamowienia nie ma, gdzie moje pieniadze?!
not: This is NOT buyer_money_taken_no_order if the payment was simply rejected with no debit — that is buyer_payment_failed.
This is NOT buyer_money_taken_no_order if the buyer is waiting for a refund of a returned item — that is buyer_where_refund.

intents.definition: The buyer is waiting for a refund and wants to know where it is or when it will arrive.
examples: Where is my refund? It's been a week.
When will I get my money back for the returned item?
The shop said they refunded me but I see nothing on my card.
Gdzie jest moj zwrot pieniedzy, kiedy dostane kase?
Kiedy wróci mi płatność za anulowane zamówienie?
I sent the package back days ago and still nothing came back to me.
juz drugi tydzien czekam na zwrot, oddajcie mi moje pieniadze!!
not: This is NOT buyer_where_refund if the buyer wants to stop future recurring charges — that is buyer_cancel_recurring.
This is NOT buyer_where_refund if money was debited but no order exists — that is buyer_money_taken_no_order.

intents.definition: The buyer wants to stop or cancel a recurring subscription charge on their payment method.
examples: How do I stop the recurring charges on my card?
Please cancel my subscription, I don't want to be billed again.
I keep getting charged every month, how do I turn it off?
Jak anulowac cykliczne platnosci z mojej karty?
Chcę zrezygnować z subskrypcji, żeby nie pobierało co miesiąc.
Every month the same amount disappears and I never signed up for this.
trzeci raz mi scigacie kase za subskrypcje, wylaczcie to natychmiast!!
not: This is NOT buyer_cancel_recurring if the buyer wants a refund of a charge already made — that is buyer_where_refund.
This is NOT buyer_cancel_recurring if the buyer is unhappy with the shop's product or service — that is buyer_complain_shop.

intents.definition: The buyer wants to complain about a merchant or shop and its behaviour, products, or service.
examples: The shop is ignoring my emails, can you help me with this seller?
I want to file a complaint against a merchant that scammed me.
This store took my order and never shipped anything.
Chce zlozyc skarge na sklep ktory mnie oszukal.
Sprzedawca nie odpowiada i nie wysłał towaru, co robić?
Ordered a phone, they sent me an empty box and won't reply.
ten sklep to oszusci, wziecli kase i cisza, zrobcie z tym cos!!
not: This is NOT buyer_complain_shop if the buyer wants their money back through the bank — that is chargeback_what.
This is NOT buyer_complain_shop if the buyer is only waiting for a refund the shop already approved — that is buyer_where_refund.

intents.definition: The buyer needs proof or confirmation that their payment went through.
examples: Can you send me a confirmation that my payment was successful?
I need a receipt for the payment I just made.
How do I prove to the shop that I already paid?
Potrzebuje potwierdzenia platnosci, mozecie wyslac?
Gdzie znajdę dowód, że opłaciłem zamówienie?
The store wants a screenshot showing the money went through.
dajcie mi potwierdzenie ze zaplacilem bo sklep mi nie wierzy!
not: This is NOT buyer_payment_confirmation if money was debited but the order shows unpaid — that is buyer_money_taken_no_order.
This is NOT buyer_payment_confirmation if the payment failed and needs retrying — that is buyer_payment_failed.

intents.definition: The merchant wants to know how to issue a full or partial refund to a customer.
examples: How do I refund a customer from the Panel?
Where in Refunds do I issue a partial refund?
Can I refund just part of the amount and keep the rest?
Jak zrobic zwrot klientowi w panelu?
Jak wykonać częściowy zwrot za jedno zamówienie?
Customer returned one of three items, need to give back only that portion.
musze oddac klientowi kase juz teraz, gdzie sie klika ten zwrot?!
not: This is NOT refund_how if the merchant asks when an already-issued refund will land — that is refund_status_time.
This is NOT refund_how if the merchant wants to refund many orders from a file — that is refund_bulk.

intents.definition: The merchant wants to know the timing or status of a refund they already issued.
examples: How long does a refund take to reach the customer?
The refund shows pending, when will it complete?
What do the refund statuses in the Panel mean?
Ile trwa zwrot do klienta, kiedy dojdzie kasa?
Zwrot ma status w toku, kiedy się zakończy?
I refunded three days ago and the client says nothing arrived yet.
klient wydzwania ze zwrotu nie ma, kiedy w koncu dojdzie?!
not: This is NOT refund_status_time if the merchant asks how to create the refund in the first place — that is refund_how.
This is NOT refund_status_time if the buyer (not merchant) is chasing their money — that is buyer_where_refund.

intents.definition: The merchant wants to know how refunds work for special cases like an expired card or BLIK specifics.
examples: How do I refund a payment made with a card that has now expired?
The customer's card is expired, will the refund still reach them?
How does a BLIK refund work, does it go back to the app?
Jak zrobic zwrot na karte ktora juz wygasla?
Czy zwrot BLIK trafi na to samo konto co płatność?
Client changed banks and the old card is dead — where does the money land?
karta klienta wygasla a on chce zwrot, jak to w ogole ma dzialac?
not: This is NOT refund_special_method if the question is only about generic refund timing — that is refund_status_time.
This is NOT refund_special_method if the refund is blocked because it is past 180 days — that is refund_after_window.

intents.definition: The merchant wants to issue many refunds at once, typically from an uploaded file.
examples: Can I upload a file to refund hundreds of orders at once?
How do I do mass refunds instead of one by one?
Is there a CSV import for bulk refunds in the Panel?
Jak zrobic zwrot masowy z pliku dla wielu zamowien?
Czy mogę wgrać plik i zwrócić pieniądze zbiorczo?
We cancelled a whole event, need to give back 500 people fast.
mam 800 zwrotow do zrobienia, nie bede klikac kazdego z osobna!!
not: This is NOT refund_bulk if the merchant refunds a single order manually — that is refund_how.
This is NOT refund_bulk if the concern is whether commission is returned — that is refund_fees.

intents.definition: The merchant wants to refund a transaction that is older than the 180-day refund window.
examples: Can I still refund a payment from more than 180 days ago?
The transaction is 7 months old, is a refund possible?
Refund button is greyed out on an old order, why?
Czy moge zwrocic platnosc starsza niz 180 dni?
Zamówienie sprzed pół roku — da się jeszcze zwrócić kasę?
Customer only complained now about a purchase from last winter.
transakcja stara na 200 dni a klient zada zwrotu, da sie cos zrobic?
not: This is NOT refund_after_window if the card is expired but within 180 days — that is refund_special_method.
This is NOT refund_after_window if the merchant simply asks the standard refund timing — that is refund_status_time.

intents.definition: The merchant wants to know whether transaction commission is returned when a refund is issued and what a refund costs.
examples: If I refund an order, do I get the commission back too?
Is there a fee for issuing a refund?
Does kremzaPay keep the processing fee on refunded payments?
Czy prowizja wraca do mnie przy zwrocie?
Ile kosztuje zwrot i czy tracę opłatę za transakcję?
I'm refunding a lot lately and it feels like I'm losing money each time.
oddaje klientowi kase a wy i tak zabieracie prowizje?! to jak?
not: This is NOT refund_fees if the merchant asks how to perform the refund — that is refund_how.
This is NOT refund_fees if the question is about chargeback costs specifically — that is chargeback_what.

intents.definition: The user wants to understand what a chargeback is and how the process works.
examples: What exactly is a chargeback?
How does the chargeback process work from start to finish?
A customer opened a chargeback — what does that mean for me?
Co to jest chargeback i jak to dziala?
Na czym polega obciążenie zwrotne od banku?
The bank pulled money back from us and I don't understand why.
dostalem cos o chargeback i nic z tego nie rozumiem, wytlumaczcie
not: This is NOT chargeback_what if the user already has a dispute and asks how to fight it — that is chargeback_respond.
This is NOT chargeback_what if the user asks how a chargeback differs from a refund — that is chargeback_vs_refund.

intents.definition: The merchant received a dispute and wants to know how to respond, what evidence to submit, and the deadlines.
examples: I got a chargeback, how do I respond and what evidence do I send?
What documents win a dispute and how long do I have?
Where do I upload evidence for the chargeback in the Panel?
Jak odpowiedziec na chargeback i jakie dowody wyslac?
Ile mam czasu na odpowiedź w sporze, 14 dni?
Client claims they never got the parcel but I have the tracking, what now?
mam 3 dni do konca terminu na spor i nie wiem co wrzucic, ratujcie!!
not: This is NOT chargeback_respond if the user only asks what a chargeback is — that is chargeback_what.
This is NOT chargeback_respond if the user wants to lower how often chargebacks happen — that is chargeback_reduce.

intents.definition: The merchant wants to lower their chargeback rate and prevent future disputes.
examples: How can I reduce my chargeback rate?
What can I do to get fewer disputes from customers?
My chargeback ratio is too high, how do I bring it down?
Jak zmniejszyc ilosc chargebackow w moim sklepie?
Co robić, żeby klienci rzadziej otwierali spory?
Too many people are calling their banks instead of asking us first.
mam za duzo chargebackow i boje sie ze zablokujecie konto, co robic?
not: This is NOT chargeback_reduce if the merchant has a specific open dispute to answer — that is chargeback_respond.
This is NOT chargeback_reduce if the merchant asks whether to refund or let it go to chargeback — that is chargeback_vs_refund.

intents.definition: The user wants to understand the difference between a chargeback and a refund and which one to choose.
examples: What's the difference between a refund and a chargeback?
Should I just refund the customer or let it go to chargeback?
Is it cheaper to refund than to fight a dispute?
Czym rozni sie zwrot od chargebacku i co wybrac?
Lepiej zwrócić kasę czy walczyć ze sporem?
Customer threatens the bank — do I give the money back myself instead?
nie wiem czy robic zwrot czy czekac na chargeback, co mi sie oplaca?
not: This is NOT chargeback_vs_refund if the user only asks how to make a refund — that is refund_how.
This is NOT chargeback_vs_refund if the user asks how to respond to an already-open dispute — that is chargeback_respond.
